# 00000004363

**KK2-03 ★** — source: 131_代数K理论II_迹方法.md

**English.** Definition: The Frobenius and Verschiebung of TC are the canonical operators on topological cyclic homology. Conjecture: The operator ring generated by the two operators on homotopy groups is the noncommutative polynomial ring modulo one explicit quadratic relation, and this presentation is complete and universal for all cyclotomic spectra. (quadratic presentation of the TC operator ring)

**中文。** 定义：TC 的 Frobenius 与 Verschiebung 指拓扑循环同调上的典范算子。猜想：两算子在同伦群上生成的算子环为非交换多项式环模一条显式二次关系,该呈现完备且对一切分圆谱普适。（TC 算子环二次呈现）
